name: Spark Growth Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Spark Growth Ventures (SGV; sparkgv.com), a San Diego 'community oriented, mid-stage, vertical-agnostic, technology VC firm' founded and run by Hem Suri (Founder & Managing Partner), which invites accredited members of its 1,000+ person community into a 'no pre-commitment' investment model. The Gilion profile resolves the name to the same domain and San Diego HQ, and SGV's own companies page lists the deals found in press (Rain, Rozana, tab32, Banjo Health). Ruled out: Spark Capital (sparkcapital.com, San Francisco; its site does not mention SGV, and no Spark Capital people appear on SGV's team page), Spark Ventures and First Spark Ventures (different firms in search results), SparkCognition (an AI company) and Spark (a YC-backed energy-permitting AI startup), which came up in the same searches. The lead's focus 'AI; Infra; Cyber; Energy' does not appear on sparkgv.com, which calls the firm a generalist investing at Series A-D, not seed.

thesis_text.value: Community-backed, largely sector-agnostic investor in mid-stage (Series A-D) technology companies, mainly software-enabled and preferably B2B, with capital-efficient models that can scale globally. It puts a strong, stable founding team first, avoids digital assets and sectors heavy in regulation or R&D, and supports companies through a network of over 1,000 members.

open_items: No funds found: no fund name, size or close date on sparkgv.com, Gilion ('Total Funds Raised: Not publicly disclosed') or press. The contact page describes a no-pre-commitment model for accredited members, which suggests deal-by-deal vehicles. SEC EDGAR refused the declared User-Agent (403), so Form D filings for any SGV SPVs were not checked.

Check size conflict not resolved from primary sources: the focus page says a typical first check of $1-4M (recorded); search snippets from NFX Signal gave a $5K-$50K range with a $25K sweet spot, which may be a per-member figure. The NFX page was not opened, so it is not recorded.

portfolio_count_reported not recorded: the firm states no count. The companies page shows 29 company cards (Oct 2026, researcher's tally, 2 exits: edisn.ai to FuboTV 2021, PathologyWatch to Sonic Healthcare 2023); Gilion lists 25 investments.

Partners: only Hem Suri (Founder & Managing Partner) holds an investing title. The about page lists 11 Board Advisors (e.g. Kimberly Davis King, ex-IDG Ventures GP; Dan Lambert, GM of Technology at Sonic Healthcare, AI/healthtech), not recorded as partners. The firm assigns no sector focus to Hem Suri.

Application: no form; the contact page asks founders to email a deck and next-raise timing (email address not recorded). application_url points to that contact page. The site says most deals close within 10 weeks of the first pitch.

requires_us_entity left unknown: the focus page says SGV invests in the US and other countries, and the portfolio includes Indian (Rozana, Redcliffe) and UK (Astra) companies, but entity structure is not stated. invests_in_indian_founders = yes is based on those Indian portfolio companies on SGV's own page, not on a stated policy.

Only 4 of the 8 recorded rounds fall in the last 24 months (Rozana, Rain, AssetWatch C, Skeps). Other recent SGV checks with no announced round naming SGV: Aalo (2026, 'Pre-Series C'; press lists only the Aug 2025 $100M Series B led by Valor and a reported but unconfirmed 2026 Series C), SpaceX (May 2025, 'Late-Stage', likely secondary), Humanly ($25M Series B, Apr/May 2026; SGV lists only a 'Pre-Series B' check; GeekWire returned 403), Interos ($20M growth round, Jan 2026, led by Blue Owl Capital and Structural Capital; SGV not named and SGV lists only a Series C check).
Skeps Series B: the only description found is the SGV news-page headline (linking to a Skeps LinkedIn post, not opened); amount and other participants unknown. Search did not find a press article.

Rounds not recorded because the round page was blocked (403/404) or did not load: Humanly 2021 $4.2M and 2023 $12M (GeekWire), PathologyWatch $25M 2021 (Business Wire), Interos $100M 2021 and Dec 2021 investor announcements (GlobeNewswire, interos.ai), Splitero $11.7M Series A 2023 (splitero.com), Good Face Project $5.65M 2022 (Yahoo), Redcliffe 2022 (Moneycontrol), Rozana via Economic Times and YourStory, SDBJ 'Spark Growth Invests Locally' (2021).
Founding year not confirmed on sparkgv.com (Gilion says 2018; search snippets said 2018 or 2020).

Company HQ / founding year not stated for Skeps, Placer.ai, Banjo Health (release datelined Washington) or AssetWatch's founding year; AssetWatch's HQ is given as Columbus, Ohio (2025) and Westerville, Ohio (2024).
